statement_blocker: The catalog omits the density hypothesis and every binder. A published exact candidate restatement is identified, but the repository does not cite or adopt it, the original 1991 source and correction history are not fully audited, and no independent reviewer has approved the source-to-statement crosswalk. Freezing a canonical root during intake would manufacture acceptance rather than record it.
domain_and_universes: Candidate source domain: positive natural alphabet size k, positive real density delta, natural threshold and dimension, finite word cube Fin n -> Fin k, finite subset of words, and a nondegenerate combinatorial line. Exact encodings, casts, universes, and typeclass context remain open for statement freeze.
conclusion: Candidate source conclusion: every sufficiently high-dimensional subset of the finite k-letter word cube with density at least delta contains all points of a nondegenerate combinatorial line. This is not yet the canonical accepted conclusion.
degenerate_case_status: No case is canonically excluded at intake. Source review must resolve k = 0, k = 1, delta <= 0, delta > 1, n = 0, empty A, threshold equality, and proper lines whose points coincide over a singleton alphabet.
